CDP2-365 Qantas points for non FF member 8.CDP2-534 EFT recoveries with baggage reason automated email sending 9. CDP2-879 - STOP emails if CCAT recoveries 10. CDP2-893 Credit card email issue fix 11. CDP2- 619 AC01/02 12. CDP2-1016 hypercare bug fix 13. CDP2-1037 Removed Japanese condition to set to Exception 14. CDP2-997 Payment EFT or CC Process Status update for EU Compensation reason 15. CDP2-1061 bugfix 16. CDP2-1242 bug fix. Payment Sent condition added for sending email for cloned recovery 17. CDP2-1249 bug fix. Added conditions for Payment details received email for US DOT 18. Modified flow to trigger email only on process statsu change
